learning_outcomes.text: To learn the basics of sampling process, pulse modulation and digital modulation techniques.
To learn the fundamentals of information theory and understand the basics of channel coding for high-quality communications

syllabus_topics: Introduction to random processes, probability, random variables, statistical averages, transformations of random variables

:Random processses, stationarity, mean, correlation and covariance functions, ergodicity, transmission of random proceses thorug linear filters, power spectral density, Gaussian processes and noise, properties of noise
Sampling process, pulse amplitude modulation, time-division multiplexing, pulse position modulation
Quantization, pulse code modulation, noise effects in PCM
:Baseband pulse transmission, matched filter, error rate due to ISI, Nyquist signaling for no ISI
Correlative level coding, M-PAM, tapped delay-line equalization, adaptive equalization, decision-feedback equalization, eye diagram
Transmission model for digital passband transmission, Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization, geometrical interpretation of signals
Correlator banks, coherent detection of signals in noise, ML decoder

Error-rate of maximum-likelihood decoder, korelasyon almacı, equivalence of correlation and matched filter receivers, detection of signals with unknown phase, hierarachy of digital modulation techniques, coherent BPSK modulation, Coherent BFSK modulation
Coherent QPSK, coherent MSK, GMSK, M-FSK
Noncoherent orthogonal modulation, noncoherent binary FSK, differential phase-shift keying, M-ary modulation, spectral efficiency
Enformasyon teorisine giriş. Karşılıklı enformasyon ve kapasite tanımları. Capacity of memoryless discrete-time and continuous-time channels
Introduction to error-control coding. Linear block codes, cyclic codes and convolutional codes. Associated encoding and deoding algorithms
